text:
emma: FYI noticed invoice-preview up ~1.8x for two tenants after last night's deploy. quick triage shows session events split across two route_ids when clients switch from streaming->batch mid-session. ledger de-dupes by request_id; preview groups by route so we end up double-counting.

vik: Can you paste a sanitized example?

emma: example: 
```
{"request_id":"r-77","tenant":"t-green","route_id":"r/stream-fast","mode":"stream","tokens":95}
...later...
{"request_id":"r-77","tenant":"t-green","route_id":"r/batch-fallback","mode":"batch","tokens":85}
```

harry: So upstream routing flips the route_id. Preview agg keys by route; ledger keys by request_id -> mismatch. Two fixes: add a stable billing_id upstream, or change preview to coalesce by request_id when present.

olga: Upstream billing_id is cleaner but touches route-decider, proxies, and ingestion headers. That will take a few days + migration plan for Kafka keying.

vik: For immediate mitigation, patch preview aggregator to prefer request_id-based grouping if request_id exists, else fallback to route key. Add a feature flag and canary.

emma: Agree. Also add a tiny sampling metric to count events missing request_id so we can estimate rollout coverage for the upstream fix.

harry: Pseudocode for preview change: 
```
for window in windows:
  events = collect(window)
  by_req = group(events, key=lambda e: e.request_id)
  for k, g in by_req.items():
    if k: emit(k, sum(tokens))
    else: emit((tenant,route), sum(tokens_for_group))
```

vik: I'll take the preview patch. Plan: feature flag preview.coalesce_by_request_id default off, canary 5% tenants for 30m, monitor preview-vs-ledger delta and CPU. Rollback = flip flag.

olga: I'll start a proto RFC for optional billing_key with compatibility notes (fallback to request_id). Also doc Kafka dual-write plan and compaction job for older events.

emma: Metering-bot: please create ticket and attach logs.

metering-bot: Created MET-4012: "preview double-count on stream->batch session flips" with sample traces.

emma: Dashboards: add card for preview delta by tenant and a small histogram of token_delta when mode flips. Add alert if preview delta > 10% for top 50 tenants.

harry: Also add an opt-in debug header x-billing-debug=true we can enable for tenants to trace through the pipeline for a short window. Keep traces sampled.

vik: Opening PR with tests and perf benchmarks. ETA for canary: ~3h. Will post canary numbers here.

emma: Thanks — mitigation now, clean upstream design later. Keep it tight on monitoring and rollback path. :thumbsup:
